title: Octave Gaspard and his brothers
summary: The bandleader was Octave Gaspard, who got lots of jobs; his brother Vic played trombone, and they were the important ones because they got the work.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Barney, we were talking about, early in the interview, the band you played with in New Orleans, Gaspard, and you couldn't think of Gaspard's first name.

Well, he was well known in New Orleans. He used to get a lot of jobs, and if he'd hire you quite a bit, you had to have a little book to put the dates down so you wouldn't forget them, because in those days they didn't use much telephoning these houses. So that's the way we got along.
There was two. One was a trombone player and it was his brother and I can't think of his name.
In Charter's book he lists Vic Gaspard--
Tom, a bass player, and Edward, the bass drum.
Yeah, I guess so, but I didn't know the
drummer and the other one. I knew Vic and Octave. They were the most important ones to know because they got the work.
